sentences.en: I lost my receipt. Can I still get a refund?
sentences.zh: 我丢了发票。我能申请退款吗？

sentences.en: Please wait a moment while I write out your receipt.
sentences.zh: 请稍等，我去给你开张收据。

sentences.en: They can't assist you if you don't have your receipt.
sentences.zh: 如果没有发票，他们无法帮助你。

senses.zh: 收据，发票；收到，接到；收据存根
